newsitem.title: USA: Expeditors sees Q3 EPS btw $0.55 and $0.60.
newsitem.headline: Expeditors sees Q3 EPS btw $0.55 and $0.60.

text.p: Expeditors International of Washington Inc said Monday that earnings per share for the third quarter of 1996 could be within the range of $0.55 to $0.60 compared with $0.40 a share in the year-ago period.

The company said net income for the quarter, ended September 30, could exceed the current expectations of market analysts by roughly 25 percent. Expeditors International said in a statement that it expects net revenues could exceed 1995 levels by 35 percent.
The company attributed the better results to an unusually long and strong "peak season" and better than anticipated Inter-Asian and Trans-Pacific results.
Expeditors, an international transportation and logistics company, plans to report third quarter earnings on November 4.
